body:
## Story Points: 5 | Priority: P1 | Sprint: 3

## Summary
Real-time system statistics dashboard and date-filtered parking history report for administrators.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard: ADMINISTRATOR only; returns totalSlots, available, occupied, reserved, outOfService, activeVehicles, totalUsers, completedTransactions, revenueToday, revenueThisMonth
- [ ] All stats from real DB queries (no hardcoded values)
- [ ] GET /api/v1/admin/reports?from=...&to=...: ISO 8601 params; defaults to last 30 days
- [ ] Non-administrators receive 403
- [ ] Revenue = sum of feeAmount on COMPLETED records in date range

## Tests
AdminControllerTest (8 tests: dashboard, rates CRUD, report, role enforcement)

## Definition of Done
Dashboard shows live data; report filters by date; all 8 admin tests pass; 403 for non-admin.
